title: Rollout & Instrumentation Practice - Standup Notes (Sprint 16)
body:
Meeting: Cross-subteam standup — Console & Tooling (focused on rollout rehearsal + instrumentation practice)
Date: 2026-03-20 09:30 PT
Facilitator: Claire Huang
Attendees: Claire, Asha, Miguel, Samir, Priya, Jon (observability) — listed in collaborators + on-call rotation
Purpose: Quick sync to align UI changes, rollout gating, and analytics instrumentation before the next canary rollout window. Emphasis on telemetry consistency and rollback triggers.

1) Quick wins / highlights since last sync
- UI: basic permission hint added to user-settings modal (PR merged). Reduced confusion on missing keys — Claire.
- Rollouts: new rollout-state machine prototype deployed to staging; handles 3-tier fallback (hosted -> dedicated -> small-quantized) for overload cases — Miguel.
- Analytics: initial db schema for per-route token-cost events landed; query patterns for 7d cost trends validated — Samir.

2) Current priorities (this sprint)
- End-to-end rehearsal of canary with synthetic traffic generator (priority A). Goal: validate latency SLO and fallback behavior. Owner: Miguel.
- Instrumentation standardization: finalize event names and required fields for rollout events (start, sample, promote, abort, rollback). Owner: Samir + Jon. Must be in by 2026-03-24 to be included in rehearsal.
- UI rollout controls: add per-route manual override and an emergency-kill switch in the console. Owner: Asha. Target: UX review 2026-03-22.
- Add token-cost attribution to rollout dashboards (aggregate by model variant + region). Owner: Priya. Target: 2026-03-26.

3) Blockers / Risks
- Synthetic traffic tool (loadgen-v2) intermittently drops connections after 45m; root cause unclear. Blocks full-duration rehearsal. Blocker: Miguel. Jira: RWD-1427.
- Event schema debate: security wants to exclude full prompt text from rollout events; analytics needs prompt digest for quality regressions. Need a privacy-safe compromise (hash + length + prompt-tags). Decision required by 2026-03-21.
- Dashboard cost query currently scans raw-events and times out for >24h windows. Short-term workaround: pre-aggregate hourly slices. Longer-term: materialized views.

4) Decisions made in meeting
- Agreed to adopt prompt_digest (SHA256 prefix 8 chars) + prompt_length field instead of storing prompt body. Action: Samir to update instrumentation spec and share example payloads.
- Canary window length reduced from 4 hours to 90 minutes to limit blast radius until loadgen fix is complete. Rationale: reduces exposure and still gives signal for latency/cost regressions.
- Emergency-kill UX: add 3-step confirmation and optional reason required. This will also trigger immediate metrics tag "manual_kill" for audit.

5) Action items (owner - due)
- Miguel - stabilize loadgen-v2 (investigate connection teardown) - due 2026-03-22 - blocker for full rehearsal.
- Samir - update rollout event spec (include prompt_digest + prompt_length + model_variant + region + tokens_generated) and publish to Confluence - due 2026-03-21 - link to Confluence will be added to linked_artifacts after publish.
- Asha - prototype manual override control in UI + mockups for UX review - due 2026-03-22.
- Priya - implement hourly pre-aggregations for cost queries and add a short-lived caching layer for dashboard - due 2026-03-24.
- Claire - coordinate drill schedule with SRE and PagerDuty for rehearsal window 2026-03-23 10:00 PT - due 2026-03-21.

6) Short notes on instrumentation payload (examples)
- Minimal rollout_start event (example fields): event_name, timestamp, rollout_id, user_segment, model_variant, region, initiated_by, traffic_percentage.
- rollout_sample event: same + prompt_digest, prompt_length, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms_p50, latency_ms_p95.
- abort/rollback events must include abort_reason, triggered_by (auto/manual), and immediate_metrics_snapshot (p50/p95, error_rate).

7) Metrics snapshot (quick numbers, last 24h staging)
- avg token generation latency (p50): 74ms
- p95 latency: 310ms
- staging token-cost per 1k tokens (approx): $0.62
- error rate (5xx): 0.9% (mostly from a retry loop in the batching layer)
- canary traffic currently simulated at ~30 rps across 3 regions

8) Parking lot / follow-ups
- UI: explore adding rollout simulation preview (visualize percentage over time) — backlog ticket: RWD-1499.
- Analytics: sanity-check tag cardinality growth from prompt_digest over 30 days; add TTL-based rollup if high cardinality.
- Postmortem template: agree to capture the exact timeline when we run the rehearsal; Claire to enforce timeline capture.

9) Next meeting / rehearsal plan
- Dry-run rehearsal: 2026-03-23 10:00 PT (short checklist run through with SRE and PD on-call)
- Full canary rehearsal (if loadgen fixed): 2026-03-24 11:00 PT
- Next standup checkpoint: 2026-03-22 09:30 PT (quick sync to confirm blockers removed)

Notes added by Claire Huang at 10:05 PT.
Links referenced in discussion: Jira RWD-1427 (loadgen), PR #876 (console permission modal), Slack thread: #console-rollouts  (see linked_artifacts).
